classification.difficultyReason: Select vertically opposite, right-angle and straight-line relationships, including forming and solving a linear equation.

content.prompt: Calculate the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Two intersecting straight lines A–O–B and C–O–D, with all ordinary source blue strokes rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Upper angle COB is alpha; left angle COA is beta; right angle BOD is 62 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 62-degree angle is visible; unknown values remain hidden.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=180^\circ-62^\circ\\\alpha&=118^\circ\\\beta&=62^\circ\end{align*}$$
Adjacent angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$; vertically opposite angles are equal.

spec.description: Horizontal A–O–B, upward OU and a straight sloping line through P and O; its upper-right endpoint is unlabelled. A right-angle square lies between OA and OU. Ordinary source blue strokes are black.
spec.mathematics: The upper-right sloping ray forms 21 degrees with OB. Alpha lies between that ray and OU; beta lies between OA and OP; gamma lies between OP and OB below O.
spec.answerVisibility: The given 21 degrees and right-angle square are visible; alpha, beta and gamma remain symbolic.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=90^\circ-21^\circ\\\alpha&=69^\circ\\\beta&=21^\circ\\\gamma&=180^\circ-21^\circ\\\gamma&=159^\circ\end{align*}$$
$OU$ is perpendicular to $AB$. Vertically opposite angles are equal, and adjacent angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.

spec.description: Straight horizontal D–O–A with rays OB and OC above it, OC steeper than OB. Ordinary source blue strokes are black.
spec.mathematics: Successive angles above the straight line are 3alpha−50 degrees, alpha+20 degrees and alpha.
spec.answerVisibility: All three given algebraic angle expressions are visible; the value of alpha is hidden.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}(3\alpha-50^\circ)+(\alpha+20^\circ)+\alpha&=180^\circ\\5\alpha-30^\circ&=180^\circ\\5\alpha&=210^\circ\\\alpha&=42^\circ\end{align*}$$
